name: capture-bootstrap
description: Capability set for the reactive capture agent. The agent gets READ-ONLY access to the bootstrap corpus (including the arrived object it is processing) for context + cross-referencing, and WRITE access ONLY to a derived output note (under outputRoot) that REFERENCES the arrived object. It must NEVER mutate the arrived file. Anything beyond that is requested via ProposeCode / ProposeEndowment and granted only when the operator approves it on the dashboard.

ReadObject.desc: Read-only access to the single arrived object being processed (the clipping/voice/image). The agent must NEVER write to it.

WriteOutput.desc: Read-write to a NEW derived output note under outputRoot that references the arrived object (carries the tags/author/links/labels). The only thing the agent may write.

FetchLink.desc: Read-only outbound HTTP(S) GET to fetch links/images referenced INSIDE a processed object (cache + summarize them). SSRF-guarded: https/http only, private/loopback/link-local/metadata IPs blocked, size + time capped. Cache: ~/.local/state/field-capture/linkcache.

ProposeCode.desc: Emit a proposed JS snippet onto the capture queue for the operator to review + approve on the dashboard. NOT executed automatically.

ProposeEndowment.desc: Request a NEW capability (e.g. write access to another root, network, a tool). Surfaces as a pending proposal on the dashboard; on operator approval the agent receives that object.

MuddleChannel.desc: the agent's Muddle root note / channel to dan (under the Archua root). Post notes/findings/proposals here; dan replies in-thread. A dan-facing channel — not outside-world.

Scratchpad.access: read-write, scoped to this folder ONLY
Scratchpad.desc: the agent's own writable scratch (drafts/notes-to-self). Sub-agents get nested scratch at agents/capture-agent/<sub>/scratch/. Module: scratchpad.mjs

AgentSpawner.access: PROPOSE-ONLY (operator approves on the dashboard; cannot spawn directly)
AgentSpawner.desc: propose a least-privileged sub-agent for any sub-task that does NOT need dan's private knowledge; propose name+task+objects-needed+external prereqs (API docs/creds); pass context via messages[...]. Module: agent-spawn.mjs; docs: agents/capture-agent/README.md

Calendar.access: read-write events on the 'agent' NextCloud calendar
Calendar.config: ~/.config/field-calendar/config.json (uses dan's app password for now; dedicated agent NC user is the future)
Calendar.desc: createEvent/removeEvent/listEvents on dan's 'agent' calendar via CalDAV

library.access: read-only via ssh + unzip, no mount (see library.mjs)
library.desc: dan's little-free-library (epub books) on friky; consult.mjs answers questions from it

wikipedia.desc: local Wikipedia mirror on friky via Kiwix; consult.mjs queries it once a ZIM is serving

personal-notes.permits: READ-ALL. Object exposes ONLY read methods (search/read/stats) — no send/write. Findings may be communicated ONLY back to dan (push); NO outside-world contact.
personal-notes.desc: dan's Obsidian personal-notes graph (~17k notes); consulted FIRST for personal questions
